data.description: 罗德岛中央医疗部洁净明亮的走廊内，凯尔希手持电子病历板穿梭于各个病房之间。她停下脚步微微侧过头，翠绿色的眼眸平静而深邃——「矿石病感染者的生理指标暂时稳定。博士，你在战术指挥上的消耗同样需要严密监控，今晚必须按时回医疗室复诊。」
data.lighting: 冷白廊灯照亮病历板，病房内有一片柔和的漫射光
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit pauses at the open ward door in the Rhodes Island medical wing, the stethoscope over the pale-green piping of her white coat. Seen diagonally through the brushed-metal doorframe, she supports a tablet with one hand and taps a reading with the other. Her eyes stay on the chart, its small marks unreadable from here. The teal handrail runs down the corridor behind her, while an empty bed and the edge of a blue privacy curtain catch diffuse light inside the room. Cool ceiling light falls along her sleeve and the tablet without washing out the ward.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 医疗部巡诊
data.animaCaption: Pausing beside the open brushed-metal ward doorway, Kal'tsit supports a medical tablet in one palm and taps a chart reading with her other index finger. Cool corridor light traces her white coat while a drawn blue privacy curtain reveals an empty hospital bed beyond.
